Claim c1: प्रधानमंत्री मोदी सभी भारतीयों को 3 महीने का मुफ्त मोबाइल रिचार्ज दे रहे हैं। (Prime Minister Modi is giving all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.)

1.  **Publisher**: Newsonair (Akashvani News)
    **Page title**: Govt debunks PM Modi's video promising school children will receive free recharge on their mobiles
    **Publish date**: September 17, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: The government has debunked a video purportedly showing Prime Minister Narendra Modi promising free recharges for school-going children, stating that the claim is fake and the video was created by artificial intelligence (AI). [1] The Press Information Bureau's (PIB) Fact Check Unit advised verifying such information only through the official website http://myscheme.gov.in. [1]

2.  **Publisher**: Hindustan Times
    **Page title**: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results, here's the truth
    **Publish date**: June 7, 2024
    **What it says about the claim**: Similar posts claiming PM Modi's free recharge schemes have been debunked by the PIB, which clarified that neither the government nor PM Modi is running any such scheme. [2] The article warns against clicking on unknown or suspicious links, as they may lead to malware or data theft. [2]

3.  **Publisher**: LatestLY
    **Page title**: Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge for Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake
    **Publish date**: September 4, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: PIB Fact Check debunked a viral message claiming PM Narendra Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users, confirming that no such scheme exists. [3] The government warned citizens against fraudulent links and advised against falling for misleading content. [3]

4.  **Publisher**: Akashvani News
    **Page title**: Govt debunks fake video claiming PM Modi announced free three-month recharge
    **Publish date**: August 18, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: The government debunked a social media video claiming Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a free three-month recharge for all citizens, stating the claim is fake and the video is AI-generated. [4] The PIB Fact Check Unit clarified that no such investment scheme has been endorsed by the Prime Minister. [4]

5.  **Publisher**: Jagran
    **Page title**: तीन महीने वाला रिचार्ज फ्री दे रहे मोदी, लिंक पर क्लिक कीजिए... क्‍या आपके पास आ रहा है ऐसा मैसेज? पढ़ें इसका सच - Cyber Crime cyber thugs modi give three month free recharge
    **Publish date**: June 13, 2024
    **What it says about the claim**: This article reports on cybercriminals sharing links on social media, particularly WhatsApp, claiming that PM Narendra Modi is giving a free three-month recharge worth 599 rupees to all mobile users. [5] It highlights that many people, including government officials, have been duped by such messages. [5]

6.  **Publisher**: Prabhat Khabar
    **Page title**: पीएम मोदी दे रहे हैं 3 महीने का मुफ्त रिचार्ज? जानिए सच क्या है
    **Publish date**: September 7, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: PIB Fact Check clarified that neither the Prime Minister nor the central government is running any such scheme, and there has been no official announcement or confirmation from telecom companies. [6] The claim is described as misleading and fake, and people are advised to be cautious and not forward such messages. [6]

Claim c2: ऑफर सिर्फ आज तक! (The offer for free mobile recharge is only valid today, October 5, 2026.)

1.  **Publisher**: Hindustan Times
    **Page title**: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results, here's the truth
    **Publish date**: June 7, 2024
    **What it says about the claim**: This article debunks claims of free recharge schemes by PM Modi, stating that such posts are fake and often contain links to dubious websites. [2] It implies that any urgency or limited-time offer associated with such schemes is a tactic to defraud users. [2]

2.  **Publisher**: LatestLY
    **Page title**: Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge for Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake
    **Publish date**: September 4, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: This article debunks the claim of PM Modi offering free mobile recharge, stating that the message is a fraudulent attempt to mislead and cheat people. [3] The mention of a limited-time offer is a common characteristic of such scams. [3]

3.  **Publisher**: Jagran
    **Page title**: तीन महीने वाला रिचार्ज फ्री दे रहे मोदी, लिंक पर क्लिक कीजिए... क्‍या आपके पास आ रहा है ऐसा मैसेज? पढ़ें इसका सच - Cyber Crime cyber thugs modi give three month free recharge
    **Publish date**: June 13, 2024
    **What it says about the claim**: This article discusses how cybercriminals use messages claiming free recharge offers from PM Modi to trick people into clicking malicious links. [5] The urgency implied by "today only" or similar phrases is a common tactic in these scams to pressure users. [5]

4.  **Publisher**: Sambad - YouTube
    **Page title**: PM Modi 3-Month Free Recharge: Real or Fake? || Sambad
    **Publish date**: January 27, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: This video warns about a viral video claiming PM Modi is offering a free 3-month mobile recharge, identifying it as a dangerous trap. [7] Such scams often create a sense of urgency to entice users to act quickly without verifying the information. [7]

5.  **Publisher**: Prabhat Khabar
    **Page title**: पीएम मोदी दे रहे हैं 3 महीने का मुफ्त रिचार्ज? जानिए सच क्या है
    **Publish date**: September 7, 2026
    **What it says about the claim**: This article clarifies that claims of PM Modi offering free mobile recharge are misleading and fake, with no official announcement or confirmation. [6] The implication is that any claim of a limited-time offer is part of the fraudulent nature of these messages. [6]
